summary: ReportGenerator has multiple issues: it creates a SqlConnection directly with hardcoded credentials (including sa password in clear text), opens the connection without a using block (risk of leaked connections), uses string interpolation in SQL (injection risk), and the entire class is tightly coupled to SqlConnection, making it untestable.

items.description: Hardcoded database credentials including sa password in connection string. Use a connection string from configuration (appsettings.json / environment variables) instead.
SQL injection vulnerability: month and year parameters are interpolated directly into the SQL query. Use parameterized queries with SqlParameter.
SqlConnection is not disposed. Wrap in a 'using' statement to ensure the connection is returned to the pool even on exceptions.
Tight coupling to SqlConnection makes unit testing impossible. Inject an IDbConnection or a repository abstraction via constructor injection.
